As Goldcorp INC New (GG) Share Value Declined, Shareholder Ruffer Llp Boosted Position Posted by Pete Kolinski 20 pm
Ruffer Llp increased its stake in Goldcorp Inc New (GG) by 73.16% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ruffer Llp bought 6.28 million shares as the company’s stock declined 4.97% with the market. The institutional investor held 14.86M shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $151.47M, up from 8.58 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ruffer Llp who had been investing in Goldcorp Inc New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $8.53 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.72% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $9.71. About 9.72 million shares traded. Goldcorp Inc. (NYSE:GG) has declined 20.38% since January 5, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.38% the S&P500.
Ruffer Llp, which manages about $3.02B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mckesson Corp (NYSE:MCK) by 638,287 shares to 579,529 shares, valued at $76.88M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Foot Locker Inc (NYSE:FL) by 1.21 million shares in the quarter, leaving it with 277,247 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
